column1: # A snippet is a git argv (git is implied). User args are appended verbatim.
# "fn:<name>" dispatches to a Go function, "tool:<bin>" to an external binary.
# A "hint:" field adds a grey parameter note after the description.
# The verb cell reads "name|short...|=alias|alias": tokens before "=" are
# abbreviations, printed next to the verb; tokens after it are aliases, printed
# Flags: "hidden" hides the row, "display:..." overrides the name column,
# "nogit" marks a verb gg answers itself, with no git command behind it.
# Mutating verbs get an oplog entry plus a footer.
# Section headers ("# --- name ---") become the categories in gg help.
